plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes a scientist named Charles Buehler, who he says worked on electrostatics (the study of static electric charge) at NASA, the US space agency. Michels says Buehler insists that the effect they are discussing is real and that it works even in a vacuum, the empty conditions of space. If true, it would mean a kind of electrical push that could work beyond the air, where many critics say it should not.
